title: Monaco Win in Paris to Reclaim the French Title and Complete a Quadruple
description: Monaco are champions of France once again, winning a wild and dramatic Game 5 at the Adidas Arena 101-92 against Paris Basketball to take the Betclic Elite title a third crown in four years and the final piece of an unprecedented quadruple this season, achieved just before the team is broken up this summer. The decider delivered on every promise, and the drama began hours before tip-off with the announcement that Matthew Strazel (184-PG-2002) had been suspended for the game. Monaco's response was a stunner: they activated Mike James (185-PG-1990, college: Lamar), the American playmaker who had been absent since May 5 and on strike over unpaid wages at the club. Wearing the number 32 Strazel's number James did not weigh heavily on the game for long, but he was among the Monaco players who turned it around at the start of the fourth quarter.
